  public fun prepOptionalInteger(value: Any): Option<Int>
    =
      Cast Int optional=true
        Var value
  public fun prepWithCast<T>(value: Any, result: T = <expr>): T
    =
      Var result
  public fun prepUseCast(value: Any): Int
    =
      Call prepWithCast<Int>
        Var value
  public fun prepWithOptionalCast<T>(value: Any, result: Option<T> = <expr>): Option<T>
    =
      Var result
  public fun prepUseOptionalCast(value: Any): Option<Int>
    =
      Call prepWithOptionalCast<Int>
        Var value
  fun main()
    val value: Any
      IntLiteral 42
    Call prepUseCast
      Var value
    Call prepUseOptionalCast
      Var value
    Call prepOptionalInteger
      Var value
